user.title: Naim streamer
user.description:
Enter the IP address or host name of your Naim streamer (Uniti, Mu-so 2nd generation, NDX 2 or another model set up with the Naim app). It must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. Reserve the address in your router so it does not change.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Naim streamer found
zeroconf_confirm.description:
Add {name} ({model}) at {host}?

Tip: reserve {host} for the streamer in your router (a DHCP reservation or static lease). If the address changes, Home Assistant finds the streamer again, but only while it is on the network.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

reconfigure.title: Change the streamer address
reconfigure.description:
Enter the new address of the streamer.

Brought to you by [HiFiSync]({hifisync_url}): hi-fi system matching grounded in physics. Made by [Zero Story Points]({zsp_url}).

error.cannot_connect: The streamer did not answer. Check the address and that it is powered at the mains (network standby is fine).
error.not_naim: A device answered, but it does not look like a Naim streamer.

abort.already_configured: This streamer is already set up.
abort.not_naim: The discovered device is not a Naim streamer.
abort.wrong_device: A different streamer answers at this address.

init.title: Naim options

data_description.max_volume: Home Assistant never sets the volume above this, so a slipped slider cannot drive the system to full power. The Naim's own remote and app are not limited.
data_description.hidden_sources: Left out of the input list. Rename inputs, or disable them altogether, in the Naim app.

not_responding.message: The streamer at {host} is not responding. It is switched off at the mains or disconnected; turn it on at the streamer.

turned_off.message: The streamer is in standby. Turn it on first.

unknown_source.message: This streamer has no input or radio favourite called {source}.

address_changed.title: {name} has a new IP address
address_changed.description:
The streamer moved from {old_host} to {new_host}. Home Assistant has switched to the new address.

To stop this from happening, reserve {new_host} for the streamer in your router (a DHCP reservation or static lease). Then ignore or dismiss this message.
